author: ballzi
body: I am sincerely sorry for what I have said and done. Over the course of my ban I  have regretted it. I will change if I get unbanned. I will be a  great aspect to the community.

title: Appeal for my DDOS threat

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello. 

I just checked your logs, and looking at that, it was more than just DDoS threats. You were blatantly racist and sexually abusive to players, making inappropriate references. I understand that you regret your decision, but you should not have acted in that way. Not only that, you have only been banned for a month now, and that is not a long enough wait time. 

This appeal is denied. 

Regards,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator
